papers.title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics. Yet LSR has so far remained tied to encoder-style bidirectional architectures, and its extension to multimodal settings still relies heavily on auxiliary cross-modal modules. To address these limitations, we introduce UEmbed (Unified Embedding), a decoder-only multimodal embe
papers.llm_reason: UEmbed 直击检索/嵌入这一 RAG 与搜索的基础设施：据摘要，将 Learned Sparse Retrieval（LSR）从 encoder-only 双向架构扩展到 decoder-only 统一模型，同时产出稀疏与稠密表示并支持多模态，而不必依赖额外跨模态辅助模块。'decoder-only 统一稀疏+稠密+多模态嵌入'是可立即迁移到团队检索/RAG 技术栈的工程范式——单一 decoder backbone 同时承担词法级稀疏匹配与语义级稠密检索，并打通图像/文本。同时命中 rag-knowledge、multimodal-agent 与 inference-serving（嵌入模型即服务路径）三条主线。证据强度中等偏上：方法路径清晰且有明确的问题定位（LSR 受限于 encoder、多模态依赖辅助模块）。证据不足：全部代码/benchmark/Papers with Code 链接暂无待核验；稀疏与稠稠表示的联合训练是否互相干扰、多模态场景下的检索质量提升幅度、与现有稠密检索基座（如 BGE/GTE）的对比需正文确认。

papers.title: ACEM: A Cost Estimation Model for Agentic Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Traditional software cost estimation models, such as COCOMO II, Function Points, and Story Points, assume that development effort is primarily driven by human labor in design, coding, and testing. Agentic software engineering, where autonomous AI agents perform substantial implementation work and humans focus on planning, specification, and validation, challenges this assumption. New cost dimensions arise: large language model (LLM) token consumption across agent actions, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL
papers.llm_reason: ACEM 提出 agentic 软件工程的新成本估算模型，据摘要指出：传统 COCOMO II/功能点/故事点假设开发成本主要由人工劳动驱动，而 agent 主导实现、人类聚焦规划/规约/验证后，新成本维度涌现——LLM token 消耗跨 agent 动作、Human-in-the-Loop（HITL）成本等。'后 COCOMO 的 agent SE 成本模型'是可立即迁移到团队 agent 工程经济性评估的框架——把 token 消耗、HITL 介入次数、验证成本纳入成本方程。命中 ai-agent、coding-agent 与 planning 主线，时效性强（agentic SE 成本建模是被普遍忽视但即将成为瓶颈的方向）。证据强度中等：成本维度划分清晰但尚处模型提出期。证据不足：全部代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；成本系数的实证标定方法、与真实 agentic 项目成本的拟合度、模型可校准性需正文确认。

papers.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity
papers.llm_reason: AURORA-LM 是连续潜空间扩散语言建模的方向性工作：据摘要，不同于图像/视频/音频已大量在连续潜空间建模，文本生成仍主要依赖离散 token；现有连续语言模型要么继承非为生成与解码联合设计的嵌入空间，要么压缩自编码潜变量以适配扩散从而牺牲 token 级保真。本文选择'保留高容量的自编码表示'而非简化表示来适配生成模型（摘要截断）。趋势信号明确：连续潜空间文本生成是 LLM 架构层面的潜在范式迁移方向，与离散 token 自回归形成对照。命中 cs.CL 主线。证据不足：摘要截断，方法完整度与关键设计待正文确认；属预训练级架构研究，与推理/服务/RAG 工程栈的直接迁移距离远；代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；连续表示的 token 级保真如何保证、与离散 token 模型的质量差距需正文确认。

papers.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected
papers.llm_reason: GradCuit 聚焦测试时潜变量推理：据摘要，基于优化的潜变量推理通过在测试时优化实例特定的连续状态（冻结模型参数）来改进 LLM 输出，但现有方法经解码 token 连接状态与推理轨迹，使序列级信用分配间接且难以看清潜变量更新如何塑造后续推理。GradCuit（gradient through circuit）在选定位置插入可优化潜变量状态，使梯度可经电路直接做信用分配。趋势信号明确：测试时计算/推理时优化是当下重要方向，与 test-time compute scaling 同属一条演进线。命中 cs.LG/cs.CL。证据强度中等：问题定位（信用分配不透明）与方法思路清晰。证据不足：摘要截断；代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；潜变量插入位置的选择策略、推理质量提升幅度与计算开销需正文确认。

papers.title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
papers.abstract: Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in mo
papers.llm_reason: onepot-Bench 0 是面向实验室化学的 lab-aware in silico 基准：据摘要指出，语言模型在实验室科学（实验规划、执行、事后分析）中作用日增，但精确测量其能力困难——科学能力需要问题解决技能与领域直觉的结合，现有评测很少测量在物理实验室做可靠决策所需能力，且常依赖可能已进入训练数据的公开数据。方法论可迁移：'lab-aware + 防数据污染 + 问题解决与领域直觉解耦评测'的设计思路可借鉴到通用 agent 能力评测。命中 llm-evaluation 与 planning/benchmark 主线。但领域高度聚焦化学，与团队 AI 工程/Agent/RAG 技术栈直接迁移距离中等。证据强度中等：基准设计动机清晰。证据不足：代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；基准规模、任务类型覆盖、防污染的具体机制与公开可用性需正文确认。

papers.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
papers.abstract: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible orbit structure can become a learnable input and affect both training and generation because the realized loss and its gradient depend on the concrete pseudorandom values consumed at each optimization step. papers.llm_reason: 揭示扩散模型中伪随机流（PRNG 轨道）作为可学习输入影响生成质量：据摘要，扩散模型依赖随机输入，但在有限精度硬件上'随机性'实为伪随机规则生成的确定性数值轨道；可访问的轨道结构可成为可学习输入并影响训练与生成，因为实现的损失及其梯度依赖于每步消耗的具体伪随机值。一个小型 MLP 即可从轨道近期历史预测下一值。这是关于训练可复现性与随机数质量的反直觉发现，对关注扩散模型训练动力学/可复现性的团队有长尾参考价值。命中 cs.LG/stat.ML。证据强度中等：有可测量的可预测性证据（MLP 预测）。证据不足：代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；对最终生成质量的影响幅度、跨 PRNG 实现的普适性、缓解策略需正文确认。

papers.title: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned predicted futures, but a plausible future alone does not justify changing the action that a bimanual policy would execute. We present CoWAM, a selective intervention layer that expresses synchronization, role compatibility, and collision convergence as coordination contracts. papers.llm_reason: CoWAM 为双臂机器人策略与世界动作模型（WAM）提供选择性干预层：据摘要，WAM 用动作条件的预测未来增强机器人策略，但合理的未来本身不足以改变双臂策略应执行的动作。CoWAM 把同步、角色兼容性、碰撞收敛表达为协调契约，结合类型化可执行性检查、事件条件验证与校准的干预门控，在保持名义策略的同时做选择性干预。趋势信号中等：世界模型用于机器人是上升方向，'选择性干预 + 协调契约'的思路可迁移到任何'预测未来 + 何时干预'的 agent 架构。但领域高度聚焦双臂机器人，与团队以文本/Agent/RAG 为核心的技术栈直接迁移距离远。命中 cs.RO/cs.AI。证据不足：代码/benchmark 暂无待核验；干预门控的误报/漏报率、对真实双臂任务成功率的影响需正文确认。

papers.title: Bridging Artificial Intelligence and Power Systems Education Using a Hands-On Executable Framework
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly central to power and energy systems, supporting modeling, forecasting, optimization, and control. Yet most existing works emphasize specialized applications and offer little reusable material for newcomers or interdisciplinary learners, who increasingly rely on large language models rather than building their own. This gap points to a need for engineering-grounded AI (EGAI), in which AI workflows follow established engineering and power-system domain
papers.llm_reason: 用可执行框架桥接 AI 与电力系统教育，提出 engineering-grounded AI（EGAI）使 AI 工作流遵循既定工程与电力系统领域规范。摘要中关键词命中（RAG）为误命中——此处指教学/领域知识组织而非 RAG 检索系统。领域高度聚焦电力系统教育，与团队 AI 工程/Agent/RAG/推理技术栈直接相关性极低。忽略，除非专门做电力系统或工程教育。
